meta.description: Machine-readable prior-art novelty filter: cross-sectional CZ signals plus curated strategy-family and method-level prior art.

records.name: Abnormal Accruals
records.signal_description: Abnormal Accruals; Define Accruals as net income (ib) minus operating cash flow (oancf), divided by average total assets (at) for years t-1 and t. If oancf is missing, replace operating cash flow with funds from operations (fopt) minus the annual change in total current assets (act) plus the annual change in cash and short-term investments (che) plus the annual change in current liabilities (lct) minus the annual change in debt in current liabilities (dlc). For each year t and 2-digit sic code, regress Accruals on: the inverse of average total assets for year t-1, the change in revenue (sale) from year t-1 to t divided by total assets for t-1, propery plant and equipment (ppegt) divided by total assets for t-1.  AbnormalAccrual is the residual from this cross-sectional regression.  See code for more details.

records.name: Accruals
records.signal_description: Accruals; Annual change in current total assets (act) minus annual change in cash and short-term investements (che) minus annual change in current liabilities (lct) minus annual change in debt in current liabilities (dlc) minus change in income taxes (txp). All divided by average total assets (at) over this year and last year. Exclude if abs(prc) < 5.

records.name: Book-to-market and accruals
records.signal_description: Book-to-market and accruals; Binary variable equal to 1 if stock is in the highest Accrual quintile and the lowest BM quintile, and equal to 0 if stock is in the lowest Accrual quintile and the highest BM quintile. Exclude if book equity (ceq) is negative.

records.name: Takeover vulnerability
records.signal_description: Takeover vulnerability; 24 minus Governance Index (G). Set to missing if G is missing, or if not in the highest quartile of institutional ownership (maxinstown\_perc), or if dual share class.

records.name: Total assets to market
records.signal_description: Total assets to market; Total assets (at) divided by market value of equity.

records.name: EPS forecast revision
records.signal_description: EPS forecast revision; keep fpi == "1", last obs each month.  Signal is meanest / last month's meanest.

records.name: Earnings announcement return
records.signal_description: Earnings announcement return; Get announcement date for quarterly earnings from IBES (fpi = 6). AnnouncementReturn is the sum of (ret - mktrf + rf) from one day before an earnings announcement to 2 days after the announcement.

records.name: Asset growth
records.signal_description: Asset growth; Annual growth rate of total assets (at)

records.name: Pastor-Stambaugh liquidity beta
records.signal_description: Pastor-Stambaugh liquidity beta; Monthly excess return (ret -rf) regressed on innovations in liquidity from Pastor's website (\url{https://faculty.chicagobooth.edu/lubos.pastor/research/liq_data_1962_2018.txt}). Use 60 month rolling window regression, and require at least 36 non-missing observations.

records.name: Tail risk beta
records.signal_description: Tail risk beta; Each month, compute the 5th percentile over daily returns over all firms. For all daily return observations with return below that 5th percentile, compute the average of (log(ret/5th percentile of cross-sectional return distribution). Call that average tailEX. BetaTailRisk is the coefficient of a 120-month rolling regression of a firm's stock return on tailEX. Exclude if price less than 5 or share code greater than 11.

records.name: Systematic volatility
records.signal_description: Systematic volatility; Coefficient on daily change in the VIX of a 1-month rolling window regression of daily stock excess returns on market return and the daily change in the CBOE S&P 100 volatility index (downloaded from FRED). Require at least 15 non-missing observations.

records.name: Book to market, original (Stattman 1980)
records.signal_description: Book to market, original (Stattman 1980); Log of tangible book equity (ceqt) over market equity matched at FYE

records.name: Book to market using December ME
records.signal_description: Book to market using December ME; BM using most recent December value of market equity.

records.name: Book leverage (annual)
records.signal_description: Book leverage (annual); Total assets (at) divided by book value of equity plus deferred taxes (txditc) and preferred stock. Equity is shareholder equity (seq) if available, or book equity (ceq) plus preferred stock (pstk, if missing pstkrv, if missing pstkl), or total assets minus total liabilities (lt).

records.name: Leverage component of BM
records.signal_description: Leverage component of BM; BP - EBM, where BP = (ceq + tstkp - dvpa)/(shrout*abs(prc)), and EBM is defined above. Exclude if price less than 5.

records.name: Cash to assets
records.signal_description: Cash to assets; Ratio of quarterly cash and short-term investments (cheq) and total assets (atq).

records.name: Cash Productivity
records.signal_description: Cash Productivity; Calculate market value of equity (mve_c) as absolute price (prc) times number of shares outstanding (shrout). Cash productivity is equal to the difference between mve_c and total assets (at) divided by cash and short-term investments (che).

records.name: Cash-based operating profitability
records.signal_description: Cash-based operating profitability; Revenue (revt) minus cost (cogs) - (administrative expenses (xsga) - R&D expenses (xrd))  minus annual change in receivables (rect), annual change in investment (invt) and annual change in prepaid expenses, plus annual change in current deferred revenue (drc), long-term deferred revenue (drlt), accounts payable (ap) and accrued expenses (xacc), all divided by total assets (at) in year t. Replace all variables in the numerator with 0 if they are missing. Exclude if share code is greater 11, market value of equity, BM or total assets are missing, or if SIC code between 6000 and 6999.

records.name: Cash flow to market
records.signal_description: Cash flow to market; Net income (ib) plus depreciation (dp) divided by market equity. Exclude NASDAQ stocks.

records.name: Operating Cash flows to price
records.signal_description: Operating Cash flows to price; Operating cash-flow (oancf) divided by market value of equity. If operating cash-flow is missing, replace by difference betwee net income (ib) and level of accruals, where the latter is the annual change in current assets (act) minus the annual change in cash and short-term investments (che), minus the annual change in current liabilities (lct) plus the annual change in debt in current liabilities (dlc) plus the annual change in payable income taxes (txp) plus depreciation (dp).

records.name: Change in recommendation
records.signal_description: Change in recommendation; keep last ireccd each month, then average across analysts for each firm-month.  Define opscore as 6-ireccd.  Signal is opscore - last month's opscore.

records.name: Change in Asset Turnover
records.signal_description: Change in Asset Turnover; Annual change in AssetTurnover (defined above). Exclude if price less than 5.

records.name: Growth in book equity
records.signal_description: Growth in book equity; Ratio of book equity (ceq) to book equity in the previous year. Include only if book equity is positive this year and last year.

records.name: Change in Forecast and Accrual
records.signal_description: Change in Forecast and Accrual; Within upper half of Accruals distribution, equal to 1 if mean earnings estimate increased relative to the previous month. 0 if it decreased.

records.name: Inventory Growth
records.signal_description: Inventory Growth; 12 month change in inventory (invt) divided by average total assets.

records.name: Change in capital inv (ind adj)
records.signal_description: Change in capital inv (ind adj); Growth in capital expenditure (capx) minus average growth in capital expenditure in the same industry (two-digit SIC). If capx is missing, capital expenditure is defined as the annual change in property, plant and equipment (ppent). Capital expenditure growth is defined as the percentage growth of capx today relative to the average capx over the previous two years (.5*(capx$_{t-1}$ + capx$_{t-2}$), or as percentage growth relative to the previous year only if t-2 is missing.

records.name: Decline in Analyst Coverage
records.signal_description: Decline in Analyst Coverage; Using IBES forecasts, keep if fpi = 1, fpedats not missing, and fpedats > statpers + 30.  Binary variable equal to 1 if the number of analysts (numest) for next quarter's EPS estimate decreased relative to three months ago, and 0 if it increased.  Keep if in bottom two size quintiles among all firms to match OP's table.

records.name: Change in Net Noncurrent Op Assets
records.signal_description: Change in Net Noncurrent Op Assets; Twelve-month change in noncurrent operating assets. Noncurrent operating assets is ( (at - act - ivao) - (lt - dlc - dltt) )/at.

records.name: Change in Net Working Capital
records.signal_description: Change in Net Working Capital; Twelve-month change in net working capital. Net working capital is ( (act - che) - (lct - dlc) )/at

records.name: Change in Taxes
records.signal_description: Change in Taxes; 4-quarter change in quarterly total taxes (txtq), scaled by lagged total assets (at).

records.name: Citations to RD expenses
records.signal_description: Citations to RD expenses; Drop obs before 1975.  Set expenses for research and development (xrd) and number of citations (ncit)  to 0 if missing. Calculate Citations to RD as sum of citations over previous 5 years divided by sum of xrd over years $t-3, \ldots, \t-7$.  Drop if denominator = 0,  2 years or less in Compustat, sic in 6000s, ceq < 0.  Double independent sort using (a) size NYSE median (b) terciles of Citations to RD.  Long if in small size, highest tercile of Citations to RD, short if in small size, smallest tercile.

records.name: Composite equity issuance
records.signal_description: Composite equity issuance; 5 year growth rate of market value of equity minus 5 year stock return.

records.name: Composite debt issuance
records.signal_description: Composite debt issuance; Log of long-term debt (dltt) plus debt in current liabilties (dlc) minus log of the same variable 5 years ago.

records.name: Convertible debt indicator
records.signal_description: Convertible debt indicator; Binary variable equal to 1 if deferred charges (dc) greater than 0 or common shares reserved for convertible debt (cshrc) greater than 0.

records.name: Coskewness using daily returns
records.signal_description: Coskewness using daily returns; Signal is the sample counterpart of $E[\tilde{r}_{it} \tilde{r}_{mt}^2]/( SD[\tilde{r}_{it} ] SD[\tilde{r}_{mt}]^2$ where $\tilde{r}_{it}$ is the de-meaned stock return and $\tilde{r}_{mt}$ is the de-meaned market excess return.  Signal is computed using the past year of daily data, and using the NYSE CRSP VW index for the market (dsia), with returns continuously compounded.  See code for details.

records.name: Call minus Put Vol
records.signal_description: Call minus Put Vol; ATM Call vol minus ATM put vol

records.name: Change in call vol
records.signal_description: Change in call vol; Using OptionM vol surface, 30 day mat, delta = 0.5, find first diff of implied vol

records.name: Change in put vol
records.signal_description: Change in put vol; Using OptionM vol surface, 30 day mat, delta = 0.5, find first diff of implied vol

records.name: Change in put vol minus change in call vol
records.signal_description: Change in put vol minus change in call vol; Take difference of dVolCall and dVolPut

records.name: Credit Rating Downgrade
records.signal_description: Credit Rating Downgrade; A downgrade happens if credit rating (splticrm) decreased by at least one notch relative to the previous month.  CredRatDG = 1 if a downgrade happened over the past 3 months.  OP studies Moody's ratings changes between 1970 and 1997, but our data doesn't begin in earnest until 1986, and our sample definitions apply to returns, and this predictor implicitly averages over the past 6 months.

records.name: Customer momentum
records.signal_description: Customer momentum; Based on firms' principals customers from Compustat Segment data as in Cohen and Frazzini.

records.name: Breadth of ownership
records.signal_description: Breadth of ownership; Quarterly change in the number of institutional owners (numinstowners) from 13F data. Exclude if in the lowest quintile of stocks by market value of equity (based on NYSE stocks only).

records.name: Change in current operating assets
records.signal_description: Change in current operating assets; Difference in current operating assets (total current assets (act) minus cash and short-term investments (che)) between years t-1 and t, scaled by average total assets (at) in years t-1 and t.

records.name: Change in current operating liabilities
records.signal_description: Change in current operating liabilities; Difference in current operating liabilities (total current liabilities (lct) minus debt in current liabilities (dlc)) between years t-1 and t, scaled by average total assets (at) in years t-1 and t.

records.name: Change in equity to assets
records.signal_description: Change in equity to assets; Difference in book equity (ceq) between years t-1 and t, scaled by average total assets (at) in years t-1 and t.

records.name: Change in financial liabilities
records.signal_description: Change in financial liabilities; Difference in financial liabilities (sum of long-term debt (dltt), current liabilitites (dlc) and preferred stock (pstk)) between years t-1 and t, scaled by average total assets (at) in years t-1 and t.

records.name: Change in long-term investment
records.signal_description: Change in long-term investment; Difference in investment and advances (ivao) between years t-1 and t, scaled by average total assets (at) in years t-1 and t.

records.name: Change in net financial assets
records.signal_description: Change in net financial assets; Compute the sum of short-term investments (ivst) and investments and advances (ivao) minus the sum of long-term debt (dltt), debt in current liabilities (dlc) and preferred stock capital. Divide the difference between the current and one-year lagged sum by total assets (at) averaged over the current and previous fiscal years.

records.name: Dividend Initiation
records.signal_description: Dividend Initiation; Keep only distcd 2nd digit = 2 or 3.  Define dividend initiation as having paid a dividend in month t (divamt > 0), and not having paid a dividend in the last 24 months.  DivInit is equal to 1 if a dividend was initiated in the past 6 months, and 0 for all other stocks.

records.name: Dividend Omission
records.signal_description: Dividend Omission; Keep only distcd 2nd digit = 2 or 3.  Define firms as quarterly, semi-annual, or annual payers based on payment history.  Define a consistent payer as a firm that paid quarterly or semi-annual dividends for the past 18 months, or annual dividends for the past 2 years.  An omission is the first month where a consistent payer failed to pay a dividend over the past quarter/6-months/year.  Finally, DivOmit = 1 if there is an omission in the past 2 months and 0 otherwise

records.name: Dividend seasonality
records.signal_description: Dividend seasonality; Drop if 3rd digit of distcd = 2 or >= 6.  Assign DivSeason = 0 if there was a dividend paid in the last 12 months.  Replace DivSeason = 1 if the third digit of disctcd is 3, 0, or 1, and a positive dividend was paid 2, 5, 8, or 11 months ago, if the third digit is 4 and a dividend was paid 5 or 11 months ago, or if the third digit is 5 and a dividiend was paid 11 months ago.

records.name: Predicted div yield next month
records.signal_description: Predicted div yield next month; Using CRSP distributions, keep only distcd beginning in 12 and if the third digit of distcd is 3, 4, or 5.  Also keep only if stock paid a dividend in the last 12 months.  Define Ediv1 = div 2 months ago if distcd's 3rd digit is 0, 1, or 3.  Define Ediv1 = div 5 months ago if the distcd 3rd digit is 4.  Define Ediv = div 11 months ago if the distcd 3rd digit is 5.  Define Edy1 as Ediv1/abs(prc).  Finally, discretize Edy1 to smooth around the huge mass at 0 as follows: DivYieldST = 0 if Edy1 = 0, 1 if Edy is between 0 and 0.005, 2 if Edy1 is between 0.005 and 0.010, and 3 if Edy > 0.010.

records.name: change in net operating assets
records.signal_description: change in net operating assets; 12-month growth in Net Operating Assets scaled by lagged total assets (at). Net Operating assets are operating assets minus operating liabilities. Operating assets are total assets (at) minus cash- and short-term investments (che), operating liabilities are total assets minus long-term debt (dltt), minority interest (mib), deferred charges (dlc), book equity (ceq) and preferred stock (pstk), all items (except at and ceq) replaced with 0 if missing.

records.name: Past trading volume
records.signal_description: Past trading volume; Log of two-month lagged trading volume (vol) times two-month lagged price (prc).

records.name: Earnings consistency
records.signal_description: Earnings consistency; Average earnings growth over previous 48 months. Earnings growth is defined as EPS (epspx) minus EPS 12 months ago divided by average EPS 12 and 24 months ago. Exclude if price less than 5, absolute value of 12 month earnings growth greater 600%, or earnings growth and earnings growth 12 months ago have different signs.

records.name: Long-vs-short EPS forecasts
records.signal_description: Long-vs-short EPS forecasts; Analyst forecasted 5-year earnings growth (fgr5yr) minus 100 times the difference between mean earnings forecast (meanest) and fiscal year earnings expectations (fy0a) scaled by the absolute value of fy0a.  Drop if fpedats is missing or fpedats - statpers < 30

records.name: Earnings surprise streak
records.signal_description: Earnings surprise streak; Use fpi == 6 and only the last statpers for each anndats_act.  Define surp = (actual - meanest)/price.  Define a firm-anndats as a streak if surp has the same sign as the most recent surp observation.  Keep only streaks.  Then define signal = surp.

records.name: Earnings Surprise
records.signal_description: Earnings Surprise; EPS (epspxq) minus EPS twelve months ago - Drift, scaled by standard deviation of that expression. Drift is the average earnings growth (EPS - EPS twelve months ago) over the past two years. Exclude if price less than 5

records.name: Earnings surprise of big firms
records.signal_description: Earnings surprise of big firms; Average monthly value of EarningsSurprise (defined above) of the 30% largest companies by market value of equity in the same Fama-French 48 industry. Exclude the largest 30% of companies for EarnSupBig (not to compute the anomaly)

records.name: Enterprise component of BM
records.signal_description: Enterprise component of BM; (ceq + che - dltt - dlc - dc - dvpa+ tstkp ) / (mve\_c + che - dltt - dlc - dc - dvpa+ tstkp). Exclude if price less than 5.

records.name: Enterprise Multiple
records.signal_description: Enterprise Multiple; Market value of equity + long-term debt (dltt) + debt in current liabilities (dlc) + deferred charges (dc) - cash and short-term investments (che) , divided by operating income (oibdp). Exclude if missing book equity or negative operating income.

records.name: Earnings-to-Price Ratio
records.signal_description: Earnings-to-Price Ratio; ib / lag(market value of equity, 6 months).  NYSE stocks only.  Exclude if EP < 0.  Lag simulates the Dec 31 market equity used in original paper

records.name: Equity Duration
records.signal_description: Equity Duration; see code

records.name: Exchange Switch
records.signal_description: Exchange Switch; Binary variable equal to 1 if a firm switched from AMEX or NASDAQ to NYSE within the past year, or from NASDAQ to AMEX within the past year.

records.name: Excluded Expenses
records.signal_description: Excluded Expenses; Difference between unadjusted earnings (EPSActualUnadj) from IBES and quarterly earnings per share (epspiq). Exclude the highest and lowest 1% of values.

records.name: Analyst earnings per share
records.signal_description: Analyst earnings per share; Using IBES unadjusted forecasts, keep fpi == 1, signal is meanest.

records.name: Long-term EPS forecast
records.signal_description: Long-term EPS forecast; Lag long-term earnings forecast (fgr5yr) by 6 months.   Then keep only June observations, and fill in missing with most recent obs.  Exclude if book equity (ceq), net income (ib), deferred taxes (txdi), dividends (dvp), revenue (sale) or depreciation (dp) is missing.  Keep only

records.name: Firm Age - Momentum
records.signal_description: Firm Age - Momentum; 6 month return, restricted to the bottom quintile of the cross-sectional firm age distribution. Exclude if price less than 5 or firm younger than 12 months.

records.name: EPS Forecast Dispersion
records.signal_description: EPS Forecast Dispersion; Keep fpi = 1 and fpedats > statpers + 30.  Standard deviation of earnings estimates (stdev\_est) scaled by mean earnings estimate.

records.name: Efficient frontier index
records.signal_description: Efficient frontier index; Frontier is the residual of a regression of log(BM) on log(book equity (ceq)), long-term debt (dltt) to assets (at), capital expenditures (capx) to revenue (sale), R&D expense (xrd) to revenue, advertising expense (xad) to revenue, property plant and equipment (ppent) to assets, EBIT (ebitda) to assets, and dummies for Fama-French's 48 industry definitions. Regression is updated each month with a rolling window of 60 months.

records.name: Governance Index
records.signal_description: Governance Index; Index available from http://faculty.som.yale.edu/andrewmetrick/data.html . The index is only available every 2-3 years for each firm, we replace intermediate missing values with the latest available one.  Value-weighted.

records.name: gross profits / total assets
records.signal_description: gross profits / total assets; Revenue (sale) - cost of goods solds (cogs), divided by  total assets (at).  Drop if financial.

records.name: Growth in advertising expenses
records.signal_description: Growth in advertising expenses; Log of advertising expense (xad) minus log of advertising expense last year. Exclude if price less than 5, xad less than .1 or stock in the lowest decile of market value of equity.

records.name: Change in capex (two years)
records.signal_description: Change in capex (two years); Growth rate of capital expenditures (capx) relative to two years ago.   If capx is missing, replace with annual change in property, plant and equipment (ppent).

records.name: Change in capex (three years)
records.signal_description: Change in capex (three years); Capital expenditures (capx) divided by the sum of capital expenditures from year - 1, year -2, and year -3.   If capx is missing, replace with annual change in property, plant and equipment (ppent).

records.name: Industry concentration (sales)
records.signal_description: Industry concentration (sales); Three-year rolling average of the three digit industry Herfindahl index based on firm revenue (sale). Exclude regulated industries (4011, 4210, 4213 & year $\leq$ 1980; 4512 & year $\leq$ 1978, 4812, 4813 & year $\leq$ 1982, 4900-4999 in any year)

records.name: Industry concentration (equity)
records.signal_description: Industry concentration (equity); Three-year rolling average of the three digit industry Herfindahl index based on firm book equity. Exclude regulated industries (4011, 4210, 4213 & year $\leq$ 1980; 4512 & year $\leq$ 1978, 4812, 4813 & year $\leq$ 1982, 4900-4999 in any year)

records.name: Employment growth
records.signal_description: Employment growth; Change in number of employees (emp) between t -1 and t, scaled by average number of employees in t-1 and t. Replace hire with 0 if emp or lagged emp is missing.

records.name: Idiosyncratic risk (3 factor)
records.signal_description: Idiosyncratic risk (3 factor); Standard deviation of residuals from Fama-French three factor regressions using the past month of daily data.  Value weighted

records.name: Idiosyncratic risk (AHT)
records.signal_description: Idiosyncratic risk (AHT); Standard deviation of residuals from CAPM regressions using the past year of daily data. Require at least 100 non-missing observations.

records.name: Amihud's illiquidity
records.signal_description: Amihud's illiquidity; Past twelve month average of: daily return (abs(ret)) divided by turnover((abs(prc)*vol)

records.name: Initial Public Offerings
records.signal_description: Initial Public Offerings; 1 if IPO in the past 6-36 months.  0 otherwise.  IPO dates are taken from Jay Ritter's IPO data available at: http://bear.warrington.ufl.edu/ritter/ipodata.htm.  Missing IPO dates imply IndIPO = 0

records.name: Industry Momentum
records.signal_description: Industry Momentum; Weighted average of firm-level 6 month buy-and-hold return. Average is taken over two digit industries each month and weights are based on market value of equity.

records.name: Industry return of big firms
records.signal_description: Industry return of big firms; Average monthly return (ret) of the 30% largest companies by market value of equity in the same Fama-French 48 industry. Exclude the largest 30% of companies for IndRetBig (not to compute the anomaly!)

records.name: Intangible return using BM
records.signal_description: Intangible return using BM; In each month, run a cross-sectional regression of a firm's five-year stock return on 5 year lagged BM (defined above) and a constructed regressor that is the change in BM from 5 years ago to today plus the five-year stock return. The residual from that regression is IntanBM.

records.name: Intangible return using CFtoP
records.signal_description: Intangible return using CFtoP; In each month, run a cross-sectional regression of a firm's five-year stock return on the 5 year lagged  CFP = (net income (ni) plus depreciation (dp))/market value of equity and a constructed regressor that is the change in CFP from 5 years ago to today plus the five-year stock return. The residual from that regression is IntanCFP.

records.name: Intangible return using EP
records.signal_description: Intangible return using EP; In each month, run a cross-sectional regression of a firm's five-year stock return on the 5 year lagged  EP = net income (ni)/market value of equity and a constructed regressor that is the change in EP from 5 years ago to today plus the five-year stock return. The residual from that regression is IntanEP.

records.name: Intangible return using Sale2P
records.signal_description: Intangible return using Sale2P; In each month, run a cross-sectional regression of a firm's five-year stock return on 5 year lagged SP (defined above) and a constructed regressor that is the change in SP from 5 years ago to today plus the five-year stock return. The residual from that regression is IntanSP.

records.name: Intermediate Momentum
records.signal_description: Intermediate Momentum; Stock return between months t-12 and t-6

records.name: Investment to revenue
records.signal_description: Investment to revenue; Ratio of capital investment (capx) to revenue (revt) divided by the firm-specific 36-month rolling mean of that ratio. Exclude if revenue less than \$10m.

records.name: change in ppe and inv/assets
records.signal_description: change in ppe and inv/assets; One-year change in property, plants and equipment (ppegt) plus one year change in inventory (invt), scaled by one-year lagged assets (at).

records.name: Inventory Growth
records.signal_description: Inventory Growth; Defate invt growth using gnp deflator.  Signal is deflated invt growth rate from fiscal year t to fiscal year t-1.  Drop if 1 digit sic code is 4 or 6, or if at or ppent <= 0

records.name: Customers momentum
records.signal_description: Customers momentum; We download BEA Make-Use Tables, match to Compustat by NAICS assuming 5 year lag, compute returns within BEA 70 industries.  Then match each industry-year to matched-industry weights corresponding to IO tables as follows: for supplier mom, industry comes from cols of Use table, matched industries from the rows.  For customer mom: industry from rows of make table, matched industries from cols.  Weights exclude own-industry entries.  For each industry-month, average returns of matched industries, weighted using IO tables.  Sort industries into deciles based on matched returns, assign firm-months to industry deciles, Finally, long stocks in deciles 8-10 and short decile 1. Drop pre-1986 due to NAICS availability.

records.name: Suppliers momentum
records.signal_description: Suppliers momentum; We download BEA Make-Use Tables, match to Compustat by NAICS assuming 5 year lag, compute returns within BEA 70 industries.  Then match each industry-year to matched-industry weights corresponding to IO tables as follows: for supplier mom, industry comes from cols of Use table, matched industries from the rows.  For customer mom: industry from rows of make table, matched industries from cols.  Weights exclude own-industry entries.  For each industry-month, average returns of matched industries, weighted using IO tables.  Sort industries into deciles based on matched returns, assign firm-months to industry deciles, Finally, long stocks in deciles 8-10 and short decile 1. Drop pre-1986 due to NAICS availability.

records.name: Market leverage
records.signal_description: Market leverage; Total liabilities (lt) divided by market value of equity.

records.name: Long-run reversal
records.signal_description: Long-run reversal; Stock return between months t-36 and t-13.

records.name: Maximum return over month
records.signal_description: Maximum return over month; Maximum of daily returns (ret) over the previous month

records.name: Revenue Growth Rank
records.signal_description: Revenue Growth Rank; Rank firms by their annual revenue growth each year over the past 5 years. MeanRankRevGrowth is the weighted average of ranks over the past 5 years, that is, MeanRankRevGrowth = (5*Rank$_{t-1}$ + 4*Rank$_{t-2}$ + 3*Rank$_{t-3}$ + 2*Rank$_{t-4}$ + 1*Rank$_{t-5}$)/15. Exclude NASDAQ stocks.

records.name: Momentum (12 month)
records.signal_description: Momentum (12 month); Stock return between months t-12 and t-1

records.name: Momentum without the seasonal part
records.signal_description: Momentum without the seasonal part; Average return in  other months over the previous year.

records.name: Momentum (6 month)
records.signal_description: Momentum (6 month); Stock return between months t-6 and t-1

records.name: Junk Stock Momentum
records.signal_description: Junk Stock Momentum; Mom6m. Include only stocks with a credit rating (splticrm) of BBB or lower. Drop if missing credit rating or non-standard credit rating.

records.name: Off season long-term reversal
records.signal_description: Off season long-term reversal; Average return in other months over the preceding 2-5 years.

records.name: Off season reversal years 6 to 10
records.signal_description: Off season reversal years 6 to 10; Average return in other months over the preceding 6-10 years.

records.name: Off season reversal years 16 to 20
records.signal_description: Off season reversal years 16 to 20; Average return in other months over the preceding 16-20 years.

records.name: Momentum and LT Reversal
records.signal_description: Momentum and LT Reversal; Binary variable equal to 1 if firm is in the highest Mom6m quintile and the lowest Mom36m quintile, and equal to 0 if firm is in the lowest Mom6m quintile and the highest Mom36m quintile. Exclude if price less than 5.

records.name: Return seasonality years 2 to 5
records.signal_description: Return seasonality years 2 to 5; Average return in the same month over the preceding 2-5 years.

records.name: Return seasonality years 6 to 10
records.signal_description: Return seasonality years 6 to 10; Average return in the same month over the preceding 6-10 years.

records.name: Return seasonality years 11 to 15
records.signal_description: Return seasonality years 11 to 15; Average return in the same month over the preceding 11-15 years.

records.name: Return seasonality years 16 to 20
records.signal_description: Return seasonality years 16 to 20; Average return in the same month over the preceding 16-20 years.

records.name: Return seasonality last year
records.signal_description: Return seasonality last year; Average return in the same monthin the previous year.

records.name: Momentum in high volume stocks
records.signal_description: Momentum in high volume stocks; Define momentum as Mom6m, and volume as the rolling average of the past 6 months of monthly turnover (minimum 5 months).  Independent sort stocks into 10 momentum ports and 3 volume ports. Keep if volume is in the top port, and assign signal = momentum port.  Drop if less than 2 years on CRSP.

records.name: Mohanram G-score
records.signal_description: Mohanram G-score; See code for details.  MS is only evaluated for low BM firms and comes from combining three signals related to profitability and cash flow, two signals related to income volatility, and three signals related to investment.

records.name: Net debt financing
records.signal_description: Net debt financing; Long-term debt issuance (dltis) minus long-term debt reduction (dltr) minus current debt changes (dlcch), scaled by average total assets (at) in years t-1 and t. Replace missing values of dlcch with 0. Exclude if ratio is greater than 1.

records.name: Net debt to price
records.signal_description: Net debt to price; Long-term debt (dltt) plus debt in current liabilities (dlc) plus preferred stock (pstk) plus preferred dividends in arrears (dvpa) minus treasury stock (tstkp) minus cash and short-term investments (che), scaled by market value of equity. Exclude if SIC between 6000 and 6999, or if missing value for total assets (at), net income (ib), common shares outstanding (csho), book value of equity (ceq) or price close fiscal year (prcc\_f).  Keep only 3rd B/M Quintile, following Table 4 (and in contrast to Table 1).

records.name: Net equity financing
records.signal_description: Net equity financing; Sale of common stock (sstk) minus  purchase of common stock (prstkc), scaled by average total assets (at) from years t and t-1. Exclude if absolute value of ratio is greater than 1.

records.name: Net Payout Yield
records.signal_description: Net Payout Yield; Dividends (dvc) plus purchase of common and preferred stock (prstkc) minus sale of common and preferred stock (sstk), divided by market value of equity lagged 6 months.  Exclude if NetPayoutYield is 0, financial firm based on SIC code, ceq <= 0, or less than 2 years in CRSP

records.name: Net Operating Assets
records.signal_description: Net Operating Assets; Difference between operating assets and operating liabilities, scaled by lagged total assets. Operating assets are total assets (at) minus cash- and short-term investments (che), operating liabilities are total assets minus long-term debt (dltt), minority interest (mib), deferred charges (dc) and book equity (ceq).

records.name: Operating leverage
records.signal_description: Operating leverage; Sum of administrative expenses (xsga) and cost of goods sold (cogs), scaled by total assets (at).  Use xsga = 0 if xsga is missing.

records.name: Option to stock volume
records.signal_description: Option to stock volume; Total monthly option volume (volume) over all puts and calls, divided by monthly stock trading volume (vol). Exclude if price less than 1 or share code greater 11 or option volume or stock volume data are missing for the previous month.

records.name: Order backlog
records.signal_description: Order backlog; Order backlog (ob) divided by average total assets (at) in years t-1 and t. Exclude if order backlog is 0.

records.name: Change in order backlog
records.signal_description: Change in order backlog; Define normalized order backlog  as order backlog (ob) divided by average total assets (at) in years t-1 and t. Exclude if order backlog is 0.  Signal is normalized order backlog minus normalized order backlog one year ago.

records.name: Organizational capital
records.signal_description: Organizational capital; Defined recursively. Set xsga to 0 if missing.  Initialize with OrgCap = 4*general expenses (xsga) in the first year, and calculate as .85*OrgCap previous year + xsga/gnpdeflator current year thereafter. Scale by total assets (at).  Keep only december year ends, and non-financials, and non-missing sic code.  Then winsoriz at the 1% level and standardized by subtracting the same month within-industry mean (Fama French 17 industries) and dividing by the same month within industry standard deviation of OrgCap.

records.name: O Score
records.signal_description: O Score; OScore = -1.32 - .407*log(at/GNP deflator) + 6.03*(lt/at) - 1.43*( (act - lct)/at) + .076*(lct/act) - 1.72*I(lt > at) - 2.37*(ib/at) - 1.83*(fopt/lt) + .285*(ib + ib$_{t-12}$ + ib$_{t-24}$ < 0) -  .521*( (ib - ib$_{t-12}$)/(abs(ib) + .abs(ib$_{t-12}$)) ). fopt = oancf if fopt is missing.  Exclude Exclude if SIC code between 3999 and 4999, or greater than 5999. Exclude if price less than 5.  Then exclude if OScore is in bottom quintile of OScore (original paper shows non-monotonic returns, as does our replication)

records.name: Patents to RD expenses
records.signal_description: Patents to RD expenses; Drop obs before 1975.  Set expenses for research and development (xrd) and number of patents (npat)  to 0 if missing. Calculate Patents to RD as patents in a year divided by $xrd_{t-2} + .8 xrd_{t-3} + .6 xrd_{t-4} + .4xrd_{t-5} + .2 xrd_{t-6}$. Drop if denominator = 0,  2 years or less in Compustat, sic in 6000s, ceq < 0.  Double independent sort using (a) size NYSE median (b) terciles of Patents to RD.  Long if in small size, highest tercile of Patents to RD, short if in small size, smallest tercile.

records.name: Payout Yield
records.signal_description: Payout Yield; Sum of dividends (dvc), purchase of common and preferred stock (prstkc) and max(preferred stock redemption value (pstkrv), 0) over market value of equity lagged 6 months.  Exclude if PayoutYield $\leq$ 0, financial firm based on SIC code, ceq <= 0, or less than 2 years in CRSP

records.name: Percent Operating Accruals
records.signal_description: Percent Operating Accruals; Income before extraordinary items (ib) minus net cash flow (oancf) divided by absolute value of ib. If oancf is missing, PctAcc is defined as ( (act - act$_{t-12}$) - (che - che$_{t-12}$) - (  (lct - lct$_{t-12}$) - (dlc - dlc$_{t-12}$) - (txp - txp$_{t-12}$) - dp ) )/abs(ib). In either case, if ib is equal to 0, divide by .01 instead. Exclude if price less than 5.

records.name: Percent Total Accruals
records.signal_description: Percent Total Accruals; Net income (ni) minus (purchase of common and preferred stock (prstkcc) minus sale of common and preferred stock (sstk) plus dividends (dvt), cash flow from operations (oancf), from financing (fincf) and investment (ivncf)). Scaled by absolute value of net income.

records.name: Price
records.signal_description: Price; Log of absolute value of price (prc).

records.name: Price delay r square
records.signal_description: Price delay r square; Each July regress stock return on day $t$ on market return in $t, t-1, \ldots, t-4$ using observations from July 1 of the previous year to June 30 of the current year.  Then regress again with no market return lags.  PriceDelay Rsq = 1 - [Rsq from second regression]/[Rsq from first regression]

records.name: Piotroski F-score
records.signal_description: Piotroski F-score; Sum of nine indicator variables which are: 1 if net income (ib) greater 0; 1 if net cash flow (oancf) greater 0; 1 if return on assets (ib/at) increased relative to previous year; 1 if net cash flow greater net income; 1 if long-term debt to assets (dltt/at) declined over the previous year;  if current assets to current liabilities (act/lct) increased over the previous year; 1 if ebit/sale (ebit = ib + txt + xint) increased over the previous year; 1 if revenue to assets increased over the previous year; 1 if shrout $\leq$ shrout last year. Include highest quintile of book-to-market only.  Exclude if missing any of the input variables.

records.name: R&D over market cap
records.signal_description: R&D over market cap; R&D expense (xrd) over market value of equity.

records.name: R&D ability
records.signal_description: R&D ability; Regress log of sales growth (sale over sale in previous year) on log of (1+ xrd/sale) in 5 bivariate regressions with (1+xrd/sale) lagged by $1, \ldots, 5$ years. Run regressions over previous 8 years and require at least 6 non-missing observations. Also require at least half of past research and development observations to be non-zero. RDAbility is the mean of the coefficients on the five lags of log(1+xrd/sale). Set to missing if firm is not in the highest tercile of xrd/sale in a year or if reseach and development expenses are non-positive.

records.name: R&D capital-to-assets
records.signal_description: R&D capital-to-assets; R&D capital to assets is the weighted sum of lagged R&D expenditures scaled by the assets (at). We replace xrd with 0 if xrd is missing and compute the numerator as $xrd_t + .8 xrd_{t-1}+ .6xrd_{t-2} + .4 xrd_{t-3} + .2 xrd_{t-4}$. Replace RDcap with missing before  1980 or if firm is in upper two thirds of market cap (shrout*abs(prc)) distribution in a month.

records.name: IPO and no R&D spending
records.signal_description: IPO and no R&D spending; Binary variable equal to 1 if R&D expense (xrd) = 0 and IndIPO = 1.  0 otherwise.

records.name: Real dirty surplus
records.signal_description: Real dirty surplus; Define Dirty Surplus as annual change in marketable securities adjustment msa plus annual change in retained earnings adjustment (recta) + .65 times the annual change in min(Unrecognized prior service cost (pcupsu) - Pension additional minimum liability (paddml),0). Real dirty surplus is the annual change in book equity (ceq) minus dirty surplus minus (net income (ni) minus dividends preferred (dvp)) + dividends (divamt) - end-of-fiscal-year-stock-price (prcc\_f)*annual change in common shares outstanding (csho).

records.name: Realized (Total) Volatility
records.signal_description: Realized (Total) Volatility; Standard deviation of residuals from CAPM regressions using the past month of daily data.  Value weighted

records.name: Analyst Recommendations and Short-Interest
records.signal_description: Analyst Recommendations and Short-Interest; Go long firms in lowest quintile of short interest (shortint/shrout) and lowest quintile of analyst recommendations (monthly consensus recommendation using the most recent analyst recommendation in the past 12 months). Go short firms in highest quintile of short interest and highest quintile of analyst recommendations.

records.name: Momentum based on FF3 residuals
records.signal_description: Momentum based on FF3 residuals; Run a rolling regression over 36 months of excess return (retrf) on excess market return (mktrf), size and value factors (smb, hml) and compute idiosyncratic returns as the one-month lagged residual. ResidualMomentum is the rolling mean of the residual divided by the rolling standard deviation of the residual, both computed over the past 11 months.

records.name: Conglomerate return
records.signal_description: Conglomerate return; Identify conglomerate firms as those with multiple OPSEG or BUSSEG entries in the Compustat segment data (and require that at least 80% of firm's total assets are covered by segment data). Compute monthly stock return at the 2-digit SIC level for stand-alone (non-conglomerate) firms only, and match those returns to conglomerates' segments. Compute weighted conglomerate return as the industry return of stand-alone companies, weighted with a conglomerate's total sales in each industry.

records.name: Return skewness
records.signal_description: Return skewness; Skewness of daily returns (ret) over previous month.

records.name: Idiosyncratic skewness (3F model)
records.signal_description: Idiosyncratic skewness (3F model); Skewness of idiosyncratic returns computed as residuals from regression of daily excess returns (ret - rf) on Fama-French factors (mktrf, smb, hml) over the previous month. We require at least 15 non-missing observations.

records.name: Earnings forecast revisions
records.signal_description: Earnings forecast revisions; Define revisions as the change in the mean earnings estimate (meanest) for the next quarter from month t-1 to t, scaled by stock price in month t-1. REV6 is the sum of that variable from months t-6 to t.

records.name: Revenue Surprise
records.signal_description: Revenue Surprise; Define revenue per share as quarterly revenue (revtq) divided by quarterly common shares outstanding (cshprq). RevenueSurprise is the 4-quarter change in revenue per share minus the average 4-quarter change in revenue per share over the previous 2 years. RevenueSurprise is scaled by its standard deviation over the previous 2 years. Exclude if price less than 5.

records.name: Inst Own and Forecast Dispersion
records.signal_description: Inst Own and Forecast Dispersion; Follow RIO\_MB, except define Disp as the stdev of IBES forecasts where fpi == 1 divided by at, and sort on Disp instead of MB.  Finally, let RIO\_Disp = lagged RIO quntile if the Disp quintile >= 4.

records.name: Inst Own and Market to Book
records.signal_description: Inst Own and Market to Book; Residual institutional ownership (RIO) is defined as log(institutional ownership (instown\_perc)/(1-institutional ownership)) + 23.6 - 2.89*log(market value of equity) +.08*log(market value of equity)$^2$. Replace instown\_perc with 0 if it is missing, with .9999 if it's above .9999, and with .0001 if it's below .0001. Then lag RIO by 6 months.  Keep only stocks with size > 20th percentile across exchcd == 1 or 2.  Define MB as market cap / (ceq + txditc), where txditc = 0 if missing, and MB is replaced with missing if ceq < 0.  Then sort into quintiles based on the lagged RIO, and sort into quintiles based on MB.  Finally, let RIO\_MB = lagged RIO quintile if the MB quintile = 5.

records.name: Inst Own and Turnover
records.signal_description: Inst Own and Turnover; Follow RIO\_MB, except define turnover as vol/shrout.  Let RIO\_Turnover = lagged RIO quintile if the Volatility quintile == 5

records.name: Inst Own and Idio Vol
records.signal_description: Inst Own and Idio Vol; Follow RIO\_MB, except define volatility as the rolling standard deviation of the last 12 months of the stock return.  Let RIO\_Disp = lagged RIO quintile if the Volatility quintile == 5

records.name: Realized minus Implied Vol
records.signal_description: Realized minus Implied Vol; Realized Vol (past 30 days) minus ATM Implied Vol

records.name: Return on assets (qtrly)
records.signal_description: Return on assets (qtrly); Quarterly net income (ibq) divided by lagged total assets (atq).

records.name: Earnings Forecast to price
records.signal_description: Earnings Forecast to price; Median estimate for next year eps (fpi = 1) in March, divided by stock price from December.  Dec fiscal year ends only, keep only forecasts more than 90 days out.  Keep only below median analyst coverage each month.

records.name: Share issuance (1 year)
records.signal_description: Share issuance (1 year); Growth in number of shares between t-18 and t-6. Number of shares is calculated as shrout/cfacshr to adjust for splits.

records.name: Share issuance (5 year)
records.signal_description: Share issuance (5 year); 5-year growth in number of shares. Number of shares is calculated as shrout/cfacshr to adjust for splits.

records.name: Share Volume
records.signal_description: Share Volume; Let tempvol = sum of monthly share trading volume (vol) over the previous three months, scaled by 3 times common shares outstanding (shrout).  Let ShareVol = 1 if tempvol > 10%, and ShareVol = 0 if tempvol < 5%.

records.name: Size
records.signal_description: Size; Log of monthly market value of equity (abs(prc)*shrout)).

records.name: Put volatility minus call volatility
records.signal_description: Put volatility minus call volatility; Using OptionMetrics's daily volatility surfaces (vsurfd), keep last observation each month, delta = 0.50 or -0.50, and days to expiration = 30.  The signal is then the difference between put implied vol and call implied vol.

records.name: Share turnover volatility
records.signal_description: Share turnover volatility; Standard deviation of turnover (vol/shrout) over the past 36 months.

records.name: Short term reversal
records.signal_description: Short term reversal; Stock return (ret) over the previous month.

records.name: Unexpected R&D increase
records.signal_description: Unexpected R&D increase; Binary variable equal to 1 if: R&D (xrd) scaled by revenue (revt) is positive, R&D scaled by total assets (at) is positive, annual R&D growth is greater than 5%, annual growth in R&D over total assets is greater than 5%. SurpriseRD is 0 otherwise.

records.name: Tangibility
records.signal_description: Tangibility; Cash and short-term investments (che) plus .715*receivables (rect) + .547*inventory (invt) + .535* property, plant and equipment (ppent), scaled by total assets (at). Only defined for manufacturing firms (SIC $\geq$ 2000 and SIC <4000). Exclude the lowest tercile of manufacturing firms by total assets.

records.name: Taxable income to income
records.signal_description: Taxable income to income; Ratio of Taxes paid and tax share of net income. Numerator is defined as the sum of foreign (txfo) and federal (txfed) income taxes. If either one is missing, numerator is defined as total taxes (txt) minus deferred taxes (txdi). Denominator is the product of the prevailing tax rate and net income (ib). Tax rate is .48 before 1979, .46 from 1979 to 1986, .4 in 1987, .34 between 1988 and 1992 and .35 from 1993 onwards. If net income is negative, and the numerator is positive, tax is defined as 1. Exclude if price less than 5.

records.name: Total accruals
records.signal_description: Total accruals; Before 1988: Change in net working capital ((act - che) - (lct - dlc)) plus change in net noncurrent assets ( (at - act - ivao) - (lt - dlc - dltt)) plus change in net financial assets ( (ivst + ivao - (dltt + dlc + pstk)). Starting in 1988: net income (ni) minus total, operating and investment cashflows (oancf, ivncf, fincf) plus stock sales minus repurchases and dividends (sstk, prstkc, dv)). Scaled by lagged total assets (at). Replace missings in ivao, ivst, dltt, dlc, pstk sstk, prstkc, dv with 0.

records.name: Trend Factor
records.signal_description: Trend Factor; See paper section 2.1 and 2.2

records.name: Volume Variance
records.signal_description: Volume Variance; Rolling standard deviation of monthly trading volume (vol) over the past 36 months (require at least 24 observations). Include only NYSE stocks.

records.name: Net external financing
records.signal_description: Net external financing; Sale of common stock (sstk) minus dividends (dv) minus purchase of common stock (prstkc) plus long-term debt issuance (dltis) minus long-term debt reductions (dltr). Scaled by total assets (at).

records.name: Days with zero trades
records.signal_description: Days with zero trades; In each month, count the number of days with no trades. Define zerotrade as the number of days without trades plus (the sum of monthly turnover (vol/shrout) divided by 48*10$^5$), multiplied by 21/number of trading days per month. Zerotrade is the 6-month average of that variable.

records.name: Days with zero trades
records.signal_description: Days with zero trades; In each month, count the number of days with no trades. Define zerotrade as the number of days without trades plus (the sum of monthly turnover (vol/shrout) divided by 48*10$^5$), multiplied by 21/number of trading days per month. Take 1-month average.

records.name: Days with zero trades
records.signal_description: Days with zero trades; In each month, count the number of days with no trades. Define zerotrade as the number of days without trades plus (the sum of monthly turnover (vol/shrout) divided by 48*10$^5$), multiplied by 21/number of trading days per month. Take 12-month average.

records.name: Active shareholders
records.signal_description: Active shareholders; Institiutional ownership share (maxinstown\_perc) if share greater than 5 percent.  Set to missing if G is missing, or if dual share class, or if 24 minus Governance index (G) is less than 19.

records.name: Advertising Expense
records.signal_description: Advertising Expense; Advertising expense (xad) over market value of equity (shrout*abs(prc))

records.name: IPO and age
records.signal_description: IPO and age; Age is  (current year -  founding year from Jay Ritter's dataset). Exclude if IndIPO == 0.

records.name: Analyst Value
records.signal_description: Analyst Value; Value based on a three-stage dividend discount model and analyst forecasts, scaled by market value.  See code for details.

records.name: Analyst Optimism
records.signal_description: Analyst Optimism; AnalystValue (defined above) minus IntrinsicValue (defined above), divided by abs(IntrinsicValue).

records.name: CAPM beta
records.signal_description: CAPM beta; Coefficient of a 60-month rolling window regression of monthly stock returns minus the riskfree rate on market return minus the risk free rate (ewretd - rf). Exclude if estimate based on less than 20 months of returns.

records.name: Frazzini-Pedersen Beta
records.signal_description: Frazzini-Pedersen Beta; Using daily data, call tempRi the sum of today's return and the past 2 days, call tempRm the sum of today's mkt return and the past 2 days mkt return.  Regress return on tempRi and tempRm using past 5 years of data, with a minimum of 3 years.  BetaFP is the square root of the r square from this regression times the ratio of the idiosyncratic stock vol and the market vol.

records.name: Bid-ask spread
records.signal_description: Bid-ask spread; Effective bid ask spread based on Corwin-Schulz scaled by stock price.

records.name: Brand capital investment
records.signal_description: Brand capital investment; Advertising expenses (xad) divided by BrandCapital. Brand capital is computed by the perpetual inventory method. In the first year, brand capital is advertising expense divided by (.5 + .1). In subsequent years, we let brand capital depreciate with a rate of .5 and add current advertising expenses. Brand capital is scaled by total assets (at). Set to missing if advertising expense is missing.  Drop if 1st digit of sic = 4 or 6, and keep only Dec fiscal year ends.

records.name: Consensus Recommendation
records.signal_description: Consensus Recommendation; Binary variable if the monthly mean of recommendations (ireccd) over analysts is greater than 3, and 0 if it is less or equal than 1.5.

records.name: Coskewness
records.signal_description: Coskewness; Signal is the sample counterpart of $E[\tilde{r}_{it} \tilde{r}_{mt}^2]/( SD[\tilde{r}_{it} ] SD[\tilde{r}_{mt}]^2$ where $\tilde{r}_{it}$ is the de-meaned stock excess return and $\tilde{r}_{mt}$ is the de-meaned market excess return.  Signal is computed using the past 60 months of monthly data, and using the NYSE/AMEX CRSP VW index for the market (msic).  See code for details.

records.name: Debt Issuance
records.signal_description: Debt Issuance; Equal to 1 if debt issuance (dltis) greater 0 and 0 otherwise. Exclude if share code > 11 or missing book-to-market.

records.name: Deferred Revenue
records.signal_description: Deferred Revenue; Annual change in deferred revenue (drc) scaled by average total assets (at) in t-1 and t. Exclude if negative book equity (ceq), deferred revenue equal to 0 in both years, revenue less than 5m, or SIC code between 6000 and 6999.

records.name: Down forecast EPS
records.signal_description: Down forecast EPS; Keep fpi = 1.  Binary variable equal to 1 if mean analyst earnings forecast for the next quarter (meanest) has improved over the previous month, and 0 otherwise.

records.name: Firm age based on CRSP
records.signal_description: Firm age based on CRSP; Months since start of CRSP coverage.

records.name: Pension Funding Status
records.signal_description: Pension Funding Status; FR = (FVPA - PBO), scaled by market value of equity. FVPA is pbnaa from 1980 to 1986, pplao + pplao from 1987 to 1997, and pplao after 1997. PBO is pbnvv from 1980 to 1986, pbpro + pbpru from 1987 to 1997, and pbpro after 1997. Exclude if price less than 5 or  shrcd > 11.

records.name: Growth in long term operating assets
records.signal_description: Growth in long term operating assets; Annual growth in net operating assets, minus accruals. Net operating assets are (rect + invt + ppent + aco + intan + ao- ap- lco- lo) / at. Accruals are ( rect-l12.rect + invt - l12.invt + aco - l12.aco - (ap - l12.ap + lco - l12.lco) - dp ) / ((at + l12.at)/2)

records.name: Sales growth over inventory growth
records.signal_description: Sales growth over inventory growth; Percentage growth in sales (sale) relative to average sales of t-1 and t-2, minus percentage growth in inventory (invt) relative to average inventory of t-1 and t-2. Both growth terms are calculated relative to t-1 only if t-2 is missing.

records.name: Sales growth over overhead growth
records.signal_description: Sales growth over overhead growth; GrSaleToGrOverHead = Percentage growth in sales (sale) relative to average sales of t-1 and t-2, minus percentage growth in administrative expenses (xsga) relative to average administrative expenses of t-1 and t-2. Both growth terms are calculated relative to t-1 only if t-2 is missing.

records.name: Industry concentration (assets)
records.signal_description: Industry concentration (assets); Three-year rolling average of the three digit industry Herfindahl index based on firm assets (at). Exclude regulated industries (4011, 4210, 4213 & year $\leq$ 1980; 4512 & year $\leq$ 1978, 4812, 4813 & year $\leq$ 1982, 4900-4999 in any year)

records.name: 52 week high
records.signal_description: 52 week high; Price (prc/cfacshr) divided by the maximum price over the previous 12 months.

records.name: Inst own among high short interest
records.signal_description: Inst own among high short interest; Exclude all stocks with short interest (ShortInterest) below 99th percentile. IO\_ShortInterest is institutional ownership (instown\_perc).  Keep NYSE Only.

records.name: Off season reversal years 11 to 15
records.signal_description: Off season reversal years 11 to 15; Average return in other months over the preceding 11-15 years.

records.name: Medium-run reversal
records.signal_description: Medium-run reversal; Stock return between months t-18 and t-13.

records.name: Earnings streak length
records.signal_description: Earnings streak length; Number if consecutive 4-quarter increases in ibq, up to 8.

records.name: operating profits / book equity
records.signal_description: operating profits / book equity; Revenue (revt) minus cost (cogs) - administrative expenses (xsga) - interest expenses (xint), scaled by book value of equity (ceq). Exclude smallest size tercile.

records.name: Operating profitability R&D adjusted
records.signal_description: Operating profitability R&D adjusted; Revenue (revt) minus cost (cogs) - (administrative expenses (xsga) - R&D expenses (xrd)), all divided by total assets (at) in year t. Replace all variables in the numerator with 0 if they are missing. Exclude if share code is greater 11, market value of equity, BM or total assets are missing, or if SIC code between 6000 and 6999.

records.name: Option volume to average
records.signal_description: Option volume to average; Based off of OptionVolume1.  OptionVolume2 = OptionVolume1 / average of OptionVolume1 from months t-6 to t-1.

records.name: Predicted Analyst forecast error
records.signal_description: Predicted Analyst forecast error; The fitted value from cross-sectional regressions of analyst earnings' forecast errors on cross-sectional rankings of 5-year sales growth, book-to-market, AOP, and analyst long term growth.  See code for details.

records.name: Price delay coeff
records.signal_description: Price delay coeff; Each July regress daily stock return (ret) on market return (mktrf) in $t, t-1, \ldots, t-4$ with observations over the previous year. Define PriceDelaySlope as the ratio of ]1*beta on mktrf$_t-1$ + 2*beta on mktrf$_t-2$ + 3*beta on mktrf$_t-3$ + 4*beta on mktrf$_t-4$], and [beta on mktrf$_t$ + beta on mktrf$_t-1$ + beta on mktrf$_t-2$ + beta on mktrf$_t-3$ + beta on mktrf$_t-4$].

records.name: Price delay SE adjusted
records.signal_description: Price delay SE adjusted; Each July regress daily stock return (ret) on market return (mktrf) in $t, t-1, \ldots, t-4$ using observations from July 1 of the previous year to June 30 of the current year.  Trim the highest and lowest 1% of estimated coefficients, standard errors, and t-stats. Define PriceDelayTstat as the ratio of [1*tstat on mktrf$_t-1$ + 2*tstat on mktrf$_t-2$ + 3*tstat on mktrf$_t-3$ + 4*tstat on mktrf$_t-4$], and [tstat on mktrf$_t$ + tstat on mktrf$_t-1$ + tstat on mktrf$_t-2$ + tstat on mktrf$_t-3$ + tstat on mktrf$_t-4$].   Finally winsor the extreme 10 and 90 percentiles each month.

records.name: Probability of Informed Trading
records.signal_description: Probability of Informed Trading; Download parameter estimates from the archived version of Hvidkjaers website (https://web.archive.org/web/20110219024112/http://sites.google.com/site/hvidkjaer/data/data-files/pin1983-2001.zip?attredirects=0), and the page for Duarte, Hu, Young, JFE 2020 https://edwinhu.github.io/pin/ and apply Easley et al's Equation 5. Use Hvidkjaers data when available, otherwise use Duarte et al. Use Year t PIN estimates to forecast returns throughout Year t+1

records.name: Real estate holdings
records.signal_description: Real estate holdings; Industry-adjusted value of real estate holdings. Real estate holdings are (fatb+fatl)/ppegt if available, and (ppenb+ppenl)/ppent otherwise.  Drop firms in 2 digit sics with < 5 firm or missing at or missing both ppent and ppegt. Subtract monthly industry-mean at the 2 digit SIC level.

records.name: net income / book equity
records.signal_description: net income / book equity; Net income (ni) over book value of equity (ceq). Exclude if price less than 5.

records.name: Share repurchases
records.signal_description: Share repurchases; Binary variable equal to 1 if stock repurchase indicated in cash flow statement (prstkc > 0), and 0 if prstkc = 0.

records.name: Short Interest
records.signal_description: Short Interest; Short-interest from Compustat (shortint) scaled by shares outstanding (shrout). Short-interest data are available bi-weekly with a four day lag. We use the mid-month observation to make sure data would be available in real time.

records.name: Sin Stock (selection criteria)
records.signal_description: Sin Stock (selection criteria); Using Compustat Segment data, sinAlgo is defined as a binary variable equal to 1 if at least one segment of a firm is listed as being in at least one of the following industries: sic $\geq$ 2100 & sic $\leq$ 2199, sic $\geq$2080 & sic $\leq$ 2085, NAICS in \{7132, 71312, 713210, 71329, 713290, 72112, 721120\}. As in the original paper, we assume that the sin stock indicator applies to the entire history and future of the identified firm. sinAlgo is equal to 0 if the firm is not identified in the CS Segment data as a sin stock and if the firm is in one of the following industries: (sic $\geq$ 2000 & sic $\leq$ 2046) OR (sic $\geq$ 2050 & sic $\leq$ 2063) OR (sic $\geq$ 2070 & sic $\leq$ 2079) OR (sic $\geq$ 2090 & sic $\leq$ 2092) OR (sic $\geq$ 2095 & sic $\leq$ 2099) OR (sic $\geq$ 2064 & sic $\leq$ 2068) OR (sic $\geq$ 2086 & sic $\leq$ 2087) OR (sic $\geq$  920 & sic $\leq$  999) OR (sic $\geq$ 3650 & sic $\leq$ 3652) OR sic == 3732 OR  (sic $\geq$ 3931 & sic $\leq$ 3932) OR (sic $\geq$ 3940 & sic $\leq$ 3949) OR  (sic $\geq$ 7800 & sic $\leq$ 7833) OR (sic $\geq$ 7840 & sic $\leq$ 7841) OR (sic $\geq$ 7900 & sic $\leq$ 7911) OR (sic $\geq$ 7920 & sic $\leq$ 7933) OR (sic $\geq$ 7940 & sic $\leq$ 7949) OR sic $==$ 7980 OR (sic $\geq$ 7990 & sic $\leq$ 7999)

records.name: Volatility smirk near the money
records.signal_description: Volatility smirk near the money; Using OptionMetrics data, among options with duration between 10 and 60 days, implied volatility of put option with moneyness closest to but above 1 minus implied volatility of call option with moneyness closest to but below 1.  Keep only volume > 0, implied vol between 0.03 and 2.0, price > 0.125, open interest > 0.

records.name: Sales-to-price
records.signal_description: Sales-to-price; Ratio of annual sales (sale) to market value of equity.

records.name: Spinoffs
records.signal_description: Spinoffs; Spinoffs are identified as all observations in the CRSP acquisition file with valid acperm entry. Spinoff is a binary variable equal to 1 if a firm is identified in the CRSP Acquisition data and if it has at most two years of history in the CRSP stock return data. Spinoff is equal to 0 otherwise.

records.name: Up Forecast
records.signal_description: Up Forecast; Keep fpi = 1.  Binary variable equal to 1 if mean earnings forecast (meanest) decreased over the past month.

records.name: Cash-flow  to price variance
records.signal_description: Cash-flow  to price variance; Rolling variance of (ib+dp)/mve\_c over the past 60 months (minimum 24 months data required).

records.name: Volume to market equity
records.signal_description: Volume to market equity; Average monthly dollar trading volume (vol*abs(prc)) over the previous 12 months, scaled by market value of equity. Exclude if price less than 5.

records.name: Volume Trend
records.signal_description: Volume Trend; Rolling coefficient from regressing monthly trading volume on a linear time trend over a window of 60 months (require that at least 30 exist). Scale coefficient by 60-month average of trading volume.

records.name: Broker-Dealer Leverage Beta
records.signal_description: Broker-Dealer Leverage Beta; Regress quarterly stock return minus 3 month treasury bill rate (tbillrate3m) on broker dealer leverage. Use a rolling window of 40 quarters (require at least 20 non-missing observations). BetaBDLeverage is the coefficient on broker-dealer leverage. Broker-dealer leverage is the seasonally adjusted ratio of assets (FRED series BOGZ1FL664090005Q) and liabilities (FRED series BOGZ1FL664190005Q).

records.name: CAPM beta squred
records.signal_description: CAPM beta squred; Square of Beta (defined above).

records.name: Bid-ask spread (TAQ)
records.signal_description: Bid-ask spread (TAQ); TAQ-based trading costs estimates (SAS code).

records.name: Accounting component of price delay
records.signal_description: Accounting component of price delay; Monthly cross-sectional regression of PriceDelay on AccrualQuality, special items (si) scaled by average total assets (at) and earnings surprise (meanest - actual) scaled by its cross-sectional standard deviation. DelayAcct is the predicted value from that regression.

records.name: Non-accounting component of price delay
records.signal_description: Non-accounting component of price delay; Monthly cross-sectional regression of PriceDelay on AccrualQuality, special items (si) scaled by average total assets (at) and earnings surprise (meanest - actual) scaled by its cross-sectional standard deviation. DelayNonAcct is the residual  from that regression.

records.name: Change in short-term investment
records.signal_description: Change in short-term investment; Difference of the current and one-year lagged short-term investments (ivst) scaled by the mean of current and one-year lagged total assets (at).

records.name: Downside beta
records.signal_description: Downside beta; Beta of Daily stock return (ret - rf) regressed on market return (mktrf) for days for which the market return was less than the average market return over the previous year. Rolling window of 252 trading days with at least 50 observations.

records.name: Failure probability
records.signal_description: Failure probability; Failure probability is -9.16 -.058*PRICE + .075*MB - 2.13*CASHMTA -.045*RSIZE + 1.41*IdioRisk - 7.13*EXRETAVG + 1.42*TLMTA - 20.26*NIMTAAVG. PRICE is log(min(abs(prc), 15)); MB is shrout*abs(prc)/ceqq; CASHMTA is cheq/(shrout*abs(prc) + ltq); RSIZE is log(shrout*abs(prc)/ sum of shrout*abs(prc) for the largest 500 companies each month); IdioRisk is defined above, EXRETAVG is the weighted average excess return (log(1 + ret) - log(1 + mktrf)) over the previous 12 months, with weight on month t-j being $\phi^j$ and the sum scaled by $\frac{1-\phi}{1-\phi^{12}}$; TLMTA is total liabilities (ltq/(shrout*abs(prc)); NIMTAAVG is a weighted average of net income over total assets (ibq/(shrout*abs(prc) + ltq)) over four quarters, with weight $\phi^q$ on quarter $t-q$ and the sum scaled by $\frac{1-\phi^3}{1-\phi^{12}}$. $\phi = 2^{-\frac{1}{3}}$. All input variables are winsorized at the 5th and 95th percentile. Exclude if price less than 1.

records.name: Long-term forecast dispersion
records.signal_description: Long-term forecast dispersion; Standard deviation of earnings estimates (stdev\_est) scaled by mean earnings estimate.  Keep if ME is in the top 500 for the month to approximate S&P 500.

records.name: Kaplan Zingales index
records.signal_description: Kaplan Zingales index; -1.002* (net income (ni) + depreciation (dp))/total assets (at) + .283*(total assets (at) + market value of equity - book value of equity (ceq) - deferred taxes (txdi))/total assets (at) + 3.319*(debt in current liabilities (dlc) + long-term debt (dltt))/(debt in current liabilities + long-term debt + book value of equity) - 39.368*(Dividends (divamt)/total assets) - 1.315*(cash and short-term investments (che)/total assets). Replace txdi and divamt with 0 if missing.

records.name: R&D to sales
records.signal_description: R&D to sales; One year lagged R&D (xrd) divided by one year lagged sales (sale).

records.name: Return on invested capital
records.signal_description: Return on invested capital; EBIT (ebit) minus non-operating income (nopi) divided by the sum of equity (ceq), liabilities (lt) and cash (che).

records.name: Whited-Wu index
records.signal_description: Whited-Wu index; Group data by 3 digit SIC code and month to compute total sales (sale) by industry. Calculate the Whited-Wu index as -0.091*(income before extraordninary items (ib) + depreciation and amortizarion (dp)) / (4 * assets(at)) - 0.062( if the dividends per share (dvpsx_c) is not missing and greater than 0) + 0.021 * long-term debt (dltt) / at - 0.044 * log(at) + 0.102 * (twelve-month growth of Industry Sales) / 4 - 0.035 * (one-month growth of sales) / 4.

records.name: Altman Z-Score
records.signal_description: Altman Z-Score; 1.2*(current assets (act) - current liabilities (lct))/total assets (at) + 1.4*(Retained earnings (re)/total assets (at)) + 3.3*(net income (ni) + interest expense (xint) + total taxes (txt))/total assets (at) +  .6*(market value of equity/Total liabilities (lt)) + revenue (revt)/ total assets (at). Include only NYSE stocks. Exclude if SIC code between 4000 and 4999, or above 5999.  Exclude if ZScore is in bottom quintile of ZScore (original paper shows non-monotonic returns, as does our replication)

records.name: Consistently negative return
records.signal_description: Consistently negative return; Define consistent negative returns (ConsNegRet) as 1 if stock returns from months t to t-5 are all less than 0.

records.name: Consistently positive return
records.signal_description: Consistently positive return; Define consistent positive returns (ConsPosRet) as 1 if stock returns from months t to t-5 are all greater than 0.

records.name: Capex and Inventory Change
records.signal_description: Capex and Inventory Change; Annual change in property, plant and equipment (ppegt) plus annual change in inventory (invt), scaled by lagged total assets (at). Use ppent if ppegt is missing.
records.source: Chen and Zhang, JF, but retracted

records.name: Pos vs negative consistent return
records.signal_description: Pos vs negative consistent return; Binary signal equal to if ConsPosRet equal to 1, and equal to 0 if CosnNegRet equal to 1.

records.name: Sin Stock (original list)
records.signal_description: Sin Stock (original list); 0

records.name: Percent Abnormal Accruals
records.signal_description: Percent Abnormal Accruals; See AbnormalAccruals.  signal = AbnormalAccruals x lagged assets / absolute value of ni

records.name: Accrual Quality
records.signal_description: Accrual Quality; Define Accruals (tempAccruals) as (difference between current assets (act) and one-year lagged current assets) - (difference between cash and short-term investments (che) and one-year lagged cash and short-term investments) - (difference between current liabilities (lct) and one-year lagged current liabilities) + (difference between debt in current liabilities (dlc) and one-year lagged debt in current liabilities) - (depreciation and amortization (dp)) all divided by (mean of total assets (at) and one-year lagged total assets ). Create tempCAcc as tempAccruals + dp/( (at + l.at)/2), tempRev as sale/( (at + l.at)/2), tempDelRev as tempRev - l.tempRev, tempPPE as ppegt/( (at + l.at)/2) where ppegt is total gross property, plant and equipment and tempCFO as ib/( (at + l.at)/2) - tempAccruals where ib is the income before extraordinary items. Run a regression for each year and industry of tempCAcc on the current value and one year lead and lag of tempDelRev and tempPPE. Save the regression residuals and replace with missing if there are not at least 20 obersvations per year and industry. Calculate accrual quality (AQ) as the standard deviation of residuals over 4 years. If more than one observation is missing set  AQ to missing. Replace AccrualQuality by the one-year lagged AQ to make sure the signal is available at time of investment.

records.name: Accrual Quality in June
records.signal_description: Accrual Quality in June; see AccrualQuality. Update only with June values for each variable.

records.name: Total assets to market (quarterly)
records.signal_description: Total assets to market (quarterly); Total assets (at) divided by market value of equity.

records.name: Asset growth quarterly
records.signal_description: Asset growth quarterly; Annual growth rate of total assets (at)

records.name: Asset liquidity over book assets
records.signal_description: Asset liquidity over book assets; (assets (at) + 0.75*(at - short term investments(che)) + 0.5*(at- curren total assets (act) - goodwill(gdwl) - intangibles (itan)) scaled by the one-month lagged book assets (at).

records.name: Asset liquidity over book (qtrly)
records.signal_description: Asset liquidity over book (qtrly); (short term investments (cheq) + 0.75*(actq - short term investments(cheq)) + 0.5*(atq- curren total assets (actq) - goodwill(gdwlq) - intangibles (itanq)) scaled by the one-month lagged book assets (atq). Replace goodwill and intangibles with 0 if they are missing.

records.name: Asset liquidity over market
records.signal_description: Asset liquidity over market; (assets (at) + 0.75*(at - short term investments(che)) + 0.5*(at- curren total assets (act) - goodwill(gdwl) - intangibles (itan)) scaled by the one-month lagged market assets (at + end-of-fiscal-year-stock-price (prcc_f) * common shares outstanding (csho) - book equity (ceq)).

records.name: Asset liquidity over market (qtrly)
records.signal_description: Asset liquidity over market (qtrly); (short term investments (cheq) + 0.75*(actq - short term investments(cheq)) + 0.5*(atq- curren total assets (actq) - goodwill(gdwlq) - intangibles (itanq)) scaled by the one-month lagged book assets (atq) + lagged closing price (prccq) times lagged common shares outstanding (cshoq) - lagged book equity (ceqq). Replace goodwill and intangibles with 0 if they are missing.

records.name: Asset Turnover
records.signal_description: Asset Turnover; Sales (sale) divided by two year average of net operating assets. Net operating assets is the sum of receivables (rect), inventories (invt), current assets other (aco), net property, plants and equipment (ppent) and intangibles (intan), minus accounts payable (ap), other current liabilities (lco) and other liabilities (lo). Exclude if abs(prc) < 5 or AssetTurnover < 0.

records.name: Asset Turnover
records.signal_description: Asset Turnover; Sales (sale) divided by two year average of net operating assets. Net operating assets is the sum of receivables (rect), inventories (invt), current assets other (aco), net property, plants and equipment (ppent) and intangibles (intan), minus accounts payable (ap), other current liabilities (lco) and other liabilities (lo). Exclude if abs(prc) < 5 or AssetTurnover < 0.

records.name: Illiquidity-illiquidity beta (beta2i)
records.signal_description: Illiquidity-illiquidity beta (beta2i); see monthly Code

records.name: Illiquidity-market return beta (beta4i)
records.signal_description: Illiquidity-market return beta (beta4i); see monthly Code

records.name: Dimson Beta
records.signal_description: Dimson Beta; Rolling regression of daily return (ret - rf) on the same-day, one-day ahead, and one-day lagged value of the market return (mktrf). Rolling regression with 20 observations (minimum 15). BetaDimson is the sum of the three coefficients.

records.name: Net liquidity beta (betanet,p)
records.signal_description: Net liquidity beta (betanet,p); see monthly Code

records.name: Return-market illiquidity beta
records.signal_description: Return-market illiquidity beta; see monthly Code

records.name: Return-market return illiquidity beta
records.signal_description: Return-market return illiquidity beta; see monthly Code

records.name: Book to market (quarterly)
records.signal_description: Book to market (quarterly); Log of quarterly book equity over market equity.

records.name: Book leverage (quarterly)
records.signal_description: Book leverage (quarterly); Total assets (atq) divided by book value of equity plus deferred taxes (txditcq) and preferred stock. Equity is shareholder equity (seqq) if available, or book equity (ceqq) plus preferred stock (pstkq), or total assets minus total liabilities (ltq).

records.name: Brand capital to assets
records.signal_description: Brand capital to assets; Brand capital is computed by the perpetual inventory method. In the first year, brand capital is advertising expense divided by (.5 + .1). In subsequent years, we let brand capital depreciate with a rate of .5 and add current advertising expenses. Brand capital is scaled by total assets (at). Set to missing if advertising expense is missing.

records.name: Capital turnover
records.signal_description: Capital turnover; Lagged sales (sale) divided by two-year lagged assets (at).

records.name: Capital turnover (quarterly)
records.signal_description: Capital turnover (quarterly); Sales (saleq) divided by one quarter lagged assets (atq).

records.name: CF to debt
